scope: Fresh initial clone per class; same input executed three times; all mutations retained.

warehouse.sql: SELECT 1,(props->'archetype'->>'w_ytd')::numeric FROM anchors WHERE arch_type='Warehouse' ORDER BY 1

district.sql: SELECT 1,(props->'archetype'->>'d_id')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'d_ytd')::numeric,(props->'archetype'->>'d_next_o_id')::int FROM anchors WHERE arch_type='District' ORDER BY 1,2

customer.sql: SELECT 1,(d.props->'archetype'->>'d_id')::int,(c.props->'archetype'->>'c_id')::int,(c.props->'archetype'->>'c_balance')::numeric,(c.props->'archetype'->>'c_ytd_payment')::numeric,(c.props->'archetype'->>'c_payment_cnt')::int,c.props->'archetype'->>'c_data' FROM anchors c JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=c.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor'JOIN anchors d ON d.id=e.src AND d.arch_type='District'WHERE c.arch_type='Customer'ORDER BY 1,2,3

stock.sql: SELECT 1,(props->'archetype'->>'s_i_id')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'s_quantity')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'s_ytd')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'s_order_cnt')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'s_remote_cnt')::int FROM anchors WHERE arch_type='Stock' ORDER BY 1,2

orders.sql: SELECT 1,(props->'archetype'->>'o_d_id')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'o_id')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'o_c_id')::int,coalesce((props->'archetype'->>'o_carrier_id')::int,0),(props->'archetype'->>'o_ol_cnt')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'o_all_local')::int FROM anchors WHERE arch_type='Order' ORDER BY 1,2,3

new_order.sql: SELECT 1,(props->'archetype'->>'o_d_id')::int,(props->'archetype'->>'o_id')::int FROM anchors WHERE arch_type='Order'AND(props->'archetype'->>'new_order')::boolean ORDER BY 1,2,3

order_line.sql: SELECT 1,(o.props->'archetype'->>'o_d_id')::int,(o.props->'archetype'->>'o_id')::int,(l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_number')::int,(l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_i_id')::int,(l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_supply_w_id')::int,(l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_quantity')::int,(l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_amount')::numeric,l.props->'archetype'->>'ol_dist_info'FROM anchors l JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=l.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor'JOIN anchors o ON o.id=e.src AND o.arch_type='Order'WHERE l.arch_type='OrderLine'ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

history.sql: SELECT 1,(d.props->'archetype'->>'d_id')::int,(c.props->'archetype'->>'c_id')::int,(h.props->'archetype'->>'h_w_id')::int,(h.props->'archetype'->>'h_d_id')::int,(h.props->'archetype'->>'h_amount')::numeric,h.props->'archetype'->>'h_data'FROM anchors h JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=h.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor'JOIN anchors c ON c.id=e.src AND c.arch_type='Customer'JOIN anchors p ON p.dst=c.id AND p.kind='EdgeAnchor'JOIN anchors d ON d.id=p.src AND d.arch_type='District'WHERE h.arch_type='History'ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
